title: 22 March 1965: Travel: Austria to England
content:
The Beatles flew back to England from Austria on 22 March 1965, following their seven-day shoot for Help! in Obertauern.

The band flew back from Salzburg Airport, where they had arrived in Austria on 13 March 1965.

They landed at London Airport in the early evening.
